title: Billing finalize endpoint and append-only credit-note path certification

acceptanceCriteria.description: POST /billing/finalize remains a permission-gated, tenant-scoped, authenticated thin route that delegates exact close admission and frozen totals to the backend finalization policy and records the resulting audit fact.
Regeneration cannot rewrite finalized invoice lines, and concurrent finalize/generate work serializes through the same per-client transaction advisory lock with migration-owned mutation backstops.
Post-finalization corrections append reasoned, idempotent credit notes; finalization and credit history is immutable and aggregate credits cannot exceed the frozen balance.
The Billing UI displays backend subtotal, credited amount, balance, and locked state, disables invoice edits, and submits only finalize/credit intent through the mocked end-to-end operator flow.
PS-412, PS-416, billing parity, rate source-of-truth, strict TypeScript, production frontend build, and all 50 mandatory source-of-truth commands pass at the reviewed SHA.
The exact reviewed SHA is ready in Vercel Production and live on the Render API; public health and readiness return HTTP 200, and GitHub scheduled zero Actions runs.

canonicalOwners: src/services/billing-finalization-policy.ts owns period close admission, transaction locking, immutable close facts, credit idempotency, and balance enforcement
src/services/billing-invoice-totals.ts owns the exact invoice totals shared by invoice reads and finalization
drizzle/0065_billing_close_workflow.sql owns database overlap serialization, closed-period mutation rejection, append-only history, and over-credit backstops
src/routes/billing.ts carries scoped authenticated intent and audit facts without owning money policy
BillingView.tsx and BillingCloseWorkflowPanel.tsx render backend DTOs and collect operator intent only

oldOwners.delegatesTo: the already-deployed PS-412/Audit 3.6 backend close workflow and Audit 5.7 UI

backend-issued finalization subtotal, creditedAmount, balance, and lock state

sotBypass.details: The close and credit money rules remain in the backend policy and migration. Routes delegate, and React neither recomputes remaining balance nor mutates finalized invoice facts.

evidence.proves: The deployed backend owner, migration race backstops, thin scoped routes, display-only UI, current preset-window browser fixture, package script, and mandatory guard-pack wiring remain present without a second money implementation.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-412-finalized-billing with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: The migrated PGlite fixture finalizes one exact invoice group, preserves open-period writes, identifies finalized cardinality once, durably enforces credit idempotency, and repeats close/credit protections without rewriting historical facts.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-412-finalized-billing with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: Adversarial mixed finalization rolls back atomically; sibling insert/update/delete, TRUNCATE, overlapping period close, append-only history mutation, and over-credit attempts fail closed while an unrelated later period remains writable.

The real Billing UI obtains the backend-owned preset window, finalizes the selected client period, displays the locked state, disables detail edits, appends a reasoned credit memo, and renders the backend 10.12 balance. Every request is intercepted by the offline mock.

evidence.proves: Generation remains fail-closed, billing reads and exports retain backend totals, selected/purchased rate truth remains backend-owned, and the close-workflow UI remains a thin consumer.

evidence.proves: All 50 mandatory backend-truth, billing, runtime-schema, authorization, durable-worker, rate, inventory, and safety commands pass, including PS-449 and the migrated PS-412 behavioral suite.

migrations.rollbackPlan: No schema or data rollback is required. The existing 0059/0065 billing protections were not changed. Forward-revert the PS-449 certification commit if necessary; never rewrite finalized billing or credit-note history.

rollback.strategy: Forward-revert only 62a2bc1d12a4bfbc7a1769b648783025748f5edb and its packet commit, then deploy the reviewed revert. The ticket adds no runtime billing behavior or schema, so rollback must not mutate invoice, credit, order, shipment, inventory, label, or marketplace data.

liveVerification.reason: The exact implementation SHA is Production Ready on Vercel and live on the Render API. Verification used deployment metadata and credential-free health/readiness GETs only; it did not finalize or credit a live invoice or perform any provider or application-data mutation.

caveats.description: npm run test:master:quick completed 19 of 20 commands. The sole daily-orders-trend-count static guard failure is the already-recorded stale backend payload-type expectation present before PS-449; PS-449 changes no Dashboard source or DTO. All billing-specific, typecheck, build, browser, and mandatory source-of-truth gates pass.
